animation.reason: The source does not request animation; frozen manifest and expected data mark it optional. Zero dots and identical five-frame pinned dumps are consistent with a static view.

category_fit.reason: Correct service-meshes family and source-backed classification, but co-viewed pair labels cannot be assigned unambiguously, and v4 puts daemon before engine contrary to source listing. No recipe yield is claimed.
category_fit.evidence_line: modal-runtime is the core with a fan of three seams (worker gRPC: task input + control RPCs and events + management RPCs; task dispatch to the engine; filesystem HTTP over UDS to modal-daemon), and worker -> runtime / runtime -> worker is an anti-parallel pair of RPC relations between the same two boxes.
category_fit.recipe_facts: Pair co-viewed, two separate ports and directions; ownership of both labels uncertain. In v4 two distinct fan stems and heads are visible, but daemon precedes engine despite source order; third outgoing edge in v3.
